cohorts.full_census: All available source entities; counts must be stratified by entity kind. Not a complete national project census.
cohorts.resource_defined: PROJECT with one latest complete same-scope TREO Mineral Resource statement. No stage requirement.
cohorts.development: Resource-defined plus source-supported study maturity and recovery observations.
cohorts.full_evidence: Development cohort plus a valid scored observation in every one of the six domains.
cohorts.official_summary_resource_screen: Government published 2026 WA table of 20 project resource summaries. Exploratory R1/R2 ranking only: JORC categories and project scopes are not issuer-harmonized. Separate from official resource-defined, development and full-evidence cohorts.

criteria.interpretation: In-situ reported inventory; not recoverable product or success probability
Published WA government summary TREO grade. Mathematically related to ore tonnes and contained TREO; redundancy acknowledged. Screen only.
Official geometry proximity; not access, capacity or connection cost

pilot_weight_policy: Restrict scenario domain weights to active panel, then normalize; different panels are different scales.
data_uncertainty: Only explicit source bounds. Rounding bounds are reported separately from measurement uncertainty.
limitations: Pilot is not a six-domain development-potential ranking
Source reports have different effective dates; cutoff is availability, not common measurement date
No claim of latest resource completeness until source discovery covers each issuer
GIS centroid proximity is not transport feasibility
Aim C external inference requires adequate sample size and independent predictors
20-project WA government-only resource screen has unverified JORC classification/project scope and is not a six-domain development ranking

screen_evidence_policy.redundancy_note: Contained TREO, ore Mt and grade share an algebraic relationship; only reported contained TREO and grade enter exploratory screen and coefficients have no expert elicitation.
